notes.title: Playtest Grant Waves — Today 22:00 & 06:00 (GMT+3)
notes.content:
Playtest is live! We’re granting access in two waves today.

[hr]
⏰ Schedule
• Wave 1: 25 Aug, 22:00 (GMT+3)
• Wave 2: 26 Aug, 06:00 (GMT+3)
If you’re not picked in Wave 1, you’re still eligible for Wave 2.

[hr]
🪄 How to join

Open the store page below.

Click “Request Access” on the Playtest.

At wave time, install from your Library.

[hr]
🎯 Why now?
• Your pet lives on your desktop—it digs while you work.
• No timers; quick care moments to feed, pet & heal.
• QoL: no drift, small-screen clicks fixed, Adopt panel first.

[hr]
Join here → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3875660/Cozy_Pet_Life_Idle/
